student_learning_goal: I can write step-by-step code for a simple task and follow it in order.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can write step-by-step code for a simple task and follow it in order.
header.character_watermark: Coda the Coding Robot in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Write 5 steps in order for a simple task (brush teeth, walk to school, get dressed). Number them 1-5.
parts.visual_layout: Top of the page. Five numbered step boxes stacked.

image_placeholders.description: Five numbered step boxes in B&W line-art, stacked. Each ~7in × 0.7in. Labels: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 with writing lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P1_FIVE_STEPS: keywords (steps, code) name what the boxes ask for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Accept any 5 ordered steps for a simple task.

parts.student_instructions: Each grid shows Coda starting at the bottom-left. Follow the code and write where Coda ends.
parts.visual_layout: Middle. Four grid maps in a 2x2 grid.

image_placeholders.description: Four 5x5 grid maps in B&W line-art, 2-row × 2-column. Each ~3in × 3in. Pre-fills: G1 — Coda starts (0,0), code 'right, right, up, up'. G2 — code 'right, right, right, up'. G3 — code 'up, right, up, right'. G4 — code 'right, up, right, up, right'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P2_FOUR_GRIDS: keywords (grid, code) name what the maps ask for.

parts.student_instructions: Invent your own simple task. Write the code in 4-5 ordered steps.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom. A blank box with thinking-bubble icon.

image_placeholders.description: A blank box in B&W line-art, ~7in × 2.5in. Top: 'My Task: ___'. Below: 5 numbered code lines. Coda thinking-bubble icon top-right.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P3_TASK_BOX: keywords (task, code) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Accept any task with 4-5 ordered steps.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, draw a SECOND grid path of your own and write the code.
teacher_notes: Lesson 1 consolidation. Watch for unordered-list errors in Part 1 — flag for sequence reteach. Part 3 is a TRANSFER probe: 'write code for someone else to follow' — child writes a 4-step code, partner executes; if Coda gets to wrong destination the writer revises. This verifies generalisation beyond tracing the lesson examples.
